subject: MPA: security milestones, DPA redlines, and escrow options
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Shah <pshah@ledgerlane.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 10:15:00 -0800
Subject: MPA: security milestones, DPA redlines, and escrow options

Hi Priya —

Thanks again for taking the call this morning. Per our conversation, I'm attaching a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MPA) that maps the evaluation milestones to the security/compliance gates LedgerLane asked us to confirm. High level: we’re proposing a two-week sprint to complete the SIG/CAIQ, a parallel evidence sprint for SOC 2 artifacts, and a short DPA redline window. Key asks for you: confirmation on the data retention target (90d vs 365d) and whether escrow is something Legal would want scoped now or only if we reach a revenue/commitment threshold.

Draft milestones (see attached MPA: mpa-draft-v1.docx):
- Week 0 (Dec 13) — Kickoff: MAP aligned, owners assigned (Security, Legal, Procurement).
- Week 1–2 (Dec 14–Dec 27) — SIG/CAIQ completion: we’ll populate answers and provide supporting artifacts (config, access controls).
- Week 1–3 (Dec 14–Jan 3) — SOC 2 snapshot & evidence intake (we’ll share the 2026Q3 snapshot PDF).
- Week 3 (Jan 4) — DPA redline close: show final DPA version for Legal to sign.
- Week 4 (Jan 11) — Executive acceptance / PO / DocuSign sign-off.

Open items for your team (please call these out back to us):
1) Data retention requirement and any regional carveouts (default is 90 days for cache/ephemeral data; archival/backup retention negotiable).
2) SIG: do you want full CAIQ answers or a reduced pillar view for initial acceptance?
3) Escrow: LedgerLane Legal may require escrow for source/keys if production volumes exceed X; do you want to include escrow language now or as a conditional milestone?

Attachments: mpa-draft-v1.docx (MPA outline + owner table).

If helpful I can run a short workshop with your security and procurement teams on Monday — 30 minutes to walk the MPA and finalize owners. Proposed times: Mon Dec 14 11:00–11:30 PT or 15:00–15:30 PT.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Enterprise Sales 
Redwood Inference

From: Priya Shah <pshah@ledgerlane.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.ai>
Cc: Legal Ops <legal@ledgerlane.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 11 Dec 2026 09:32:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: MPA: security milestones, DPA redlines, and escrow options

Diego —

Thanks for the thorough plan. A few clarifying Qs from Legal and Security so we can commit to the dates: 

1) SOC 2: when you say "snapshot & evidence intake," do you have a SOC 2 Type II report available or just a partial evidence bundle? Our legal team typically requires at least a SOC 2 Type II report or a scoped SOC SOC2/Security snapshot plus evidence checklist.
2) SIG/CAIQ: we prefer full CAIQ answers for our initial security review (the reduced pillar view adds time on our side since we have to re-request details).
3) DPA: Legal has a few redlines around data subject rights and subprocessors; can you flag whether Redwood accepts our core DSAR timeline (30 days) and whether subprocessors list will be shared in advance?
4) Data retention: by default our policies require 365 days for transaction logs; 90 days is acceptable for ephemeral caches but not for retention of audit logs. Can Redwood accommodate 365 days for audit logs while keeping 90 days for transient caches?

Also please loop procurement (I've cc'd Legal Ops) — our decision window is tight: Procurement needs a signed DPA + PO by Jan 15 to hit our Q1 rollout. If you can commit to the timeline above we can align internal reviewers.

Attaching a short Legal checklist (for reference): legal-checklist-ledgerlane.pdf (internal).

Best,
Priya Shah
Head of Platform Security
LedgerLane

Subject: Re: MPA: security milestones, DPA redlines, and escrow options

Hi Priya —

Appreciate the detailed notes. Answers inline below and next steps: 

1) SOC 2: we have a full SOC 2 Type II from 2026 Q2 (controls audit) and we’ll produce a snapshot package for the evaluation — att: soc2-snapshot-2026Q3.pdf. The full report is under NDA; we can provide it to your Legal under an access agreement or via a secure share.

2) SIG/CAIQ: we’ll provide the full CAIQ answers in Week 1–2 as requested. We’ll assign a dedicated security engineer (Marissa) to own the CAIQ responses and mark up any control gaps.

3) DPA: Redwood can accept the 30-day DSAR timeline in principle — we will clarify subprocessors in the DPA exhibit and share the current list ahead of the redline window. If Procurement needs the subprocessors up-front, we can export the list into the Drive folder now.

4) Data retention: we can support mixed retention windows. Proposed default mapping:
   - Audit & transaction logs: 365 days (primary)
   - Ephemeral caches & inference KV: 90 days
   - Backups/archival: configurable via Annex A (can offer 7-year options for regulated accounts)

Escrow: position is usually conditional. We recommend evaluating escrow only if: a) committed annual contract value > $250k, or b) production go-live requires source escrow. If you want escrow language earlier, we can include a conditional clause in the MPA.

Next steps I’ll take this afternoon:
- Upload SOC 2 snapshot to the Drive folder and share with Legal Ops.
- Update the MPA with the DSAR acceptance and retention mapping.
- Schedule the 30-minute walkthrough (I’ll propose times after confirming Marissa’s calendar).

Related links: https://redwood.hubspot.com/deals/LL-2026-0492 | Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c

Attachments: soc2-snapshot-2026Q3.pdf

Diego
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
